name: Full Smile
verdict: Over the last 7 days, CPL spiked +47.13% as spend surged +37.32% while leads dipped -6.67%, suggesting the top campaign "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" ($984.77 of $1,351.15 total spend) is scaling into a less efficient audience. GBP engagement also dropped sharply (-62.75%), which may be compressing organic lead support and putting more pressure on paid CPL.

performance.verdict: CPL crisis confirmed; August prove-it month demands efficiency fix before any scaling.

findings.text: CPL spiked +47.13% as spend rose +37.32% but leads fell -6.67%; 3-day CPL (Jul 28–30: $73.86+$63.52+$61.48 spend, 5+3+3 leads = ~$18.57/lead) confirms deterioration vs 28-day baseline of $11.65.

6 of 9 OVERDUE MILESTONES are past-due or upcoming in August; phone-match attribution (Aug 7), credentials rotation (Aug 7), OD patient groups (Aug 14), doctor hours in GHL (Aug 14), and dashboard (Aug 31) are all unresolved — directly threatening the stay/walk scoreboard.
GBP actions collapsed -62.75% (7d); last 3 days show 0, 0, 4 actions vs a prior window averaging ~8/day — organic referral to paid is evaporating, amplifying paid CPL pressure.

Single campaign 'BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness' consumed $984.77 of $1,351.15 (28-day spend = 72.9%); with CPL now ~$18.57 on latest 3 days vs $11.65 baseline, this concentration pattern is consistent with audience saturation fatigue.

GHL shows 115 opportunities created vs 116 leads and 0 appointments, 0 won — leads are entering the pipeline but zero are converting to bookings; this is an intake/CRM processing leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Cut 'BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness' daily budget by 20% (~$14/day); hold spend flat, do not let CPL compound further.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness campaign spent $984.77 over 28 days (72.9% of total) and 3-day CPL has risen to ~$18.57 vs the $11.65 baseline — a confirmed efficiency decline. Reduce the campaign's daily budget by ~20% (approx. $14/day reduction) effective immediately to stop compounding CPL while we diagnose audience saturation. Success check: CPL returns below $14 within 5 days (by Aug 5). If CPL stays elevated after the cut, escalate to creative refresh.

suggestions.text: Resolve GHL intake processing: 115 opps created, 0 appointments booked — assign a responsible owner to work the pipeline daily before Aug 7.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 115 opportunities created against 116 leads with 0 appointments and 0 won deals — every lead that enters is stalling at intake. This is a CRM/front-desk processing failure, not an ads problem, but it breaks the August scoreboard (leads → schedules → shows → patients). Assign Lily or the new intake hire to a daily pipeline review workflow in GHL by Aug 7, aligned with the phone-match attribution milestone. Success check: at least 10 appointments booked in GHL by Aug 14 review.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP recovery: actions were 0 on Jul 27 and Jul 30 — confirm posting resumed; re-check Aug 3 before any paid offset.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 on two of the last four days (Jul 27, Jul 30) and the 7-day delta is -62.75% — organic support to paid is collapsing at the worst possible time ahead of the August prove-it month. Confirm whether GBP posts and Q&A responses are being published on schedule; a lapse here reduces direct-call volume and inflates effective CPL. Re-check on Aug 3: if GBP daily actions have not recovered to ≥6/day, escalate to content team as a prove-it blocker.
